text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Fan Fest. Meisho Doto is supposed to participate in the scavenger hunt relay race and the hide-and-seek competition…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaargh!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, it's Meisho Doto! Looks like she's just dropped the cup she borrowed for the scavenger hunt race!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it! It was just a cheap cup. Here, use this one instead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, s-s-sorry. I'm really, really, really sorry about this…

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: But now she's ready to get back in the game! She's passing on the baton—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Noooo!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: She has not passed the baton!
The baton, unfortunately, did not survive Meisho Doto's fall, placing her in dead last…
She flees in tears. I run around the campus looking until I finally find her cowering in the corner of the field.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Why… oh, why am I such a klutz? Everyone was cheering me on, too…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I'd held on to the cup and baton b-better… I could have won!
She really is torn up over this… But there's still the hide-and-seek match up next.
I'm about to encourage her to make the final push, when…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm… not going to let myself mess up!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've… b-been complimented on my hide-and-seek skills before!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Plus, I used to always hide in corners to avoid causing anyone trouble, so I think I know a thing or two about hiding places!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Okay. I'm going to do my best. I know I can.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: L-let's go!
She finds the strength in herself to get back on her feet—to me, it's a sure sign of her growth. Then, a few hours later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, I know you Mati-can't wait any longer! I'm Matikanefukukitaru, and I'll be your host for this hide-and-seek competition!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We have a lot of miraculous prizes prepared for the successful seekers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, everyone, let's get ready, get set… aaand go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! Wha-wha?! The game has already started!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But, but that's okay. Hiding here, at the very least, I won't be the first one found!
However…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We're several hours into this hide-and-seek extravaganza! The Fan Fest is about to wrap up, but…

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Dotoooo! Where are yooouu?!

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fan B
text_block_list.text: We've checked everywhere possible! I guess we'll have to go around once more!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto has yet to be found! Even the rooftop, everyone's last hope, was free of her presence! But, we've got a schedule to follow, so…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It can't be argued otherwise—Doto is the winner of the hide-and-seek competition!

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fans
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!
The competition concludes with an unexpected result.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm s-sorry… I'll try to hide somewhere more obvious when next year comes…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… actually… maybe let's not play hide-and-seek next year…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Instead, I want to… have enough confidence to talk with my fans…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My fans put in so much effort to find me… I want to repay them…
Despite the numerous slipups, it looks like this experience with her fans has inspired Doto.

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, gotcha! I found you, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gyah! You're even cuter in real life!

text_block_list.name: Doto's Fan B
text_block_list.text: I cheer you on in all your races! And I really wanted to meet you today!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! Hyayayah! Wh-wh-wh-why are th-there so many people now?!
The crowd continues to bring in more people, and before she knows it, Meisho Doto is completely surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaa!
I go in to pull her out, but by then, she's completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm… okay. I was just surprised, that's all…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I didn't know I had so many fans… It c-caught me off guard…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yet… it made me happy…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I feel power from each of my supporters… It's… amazing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But now my heart and body are all tuckered out… Sigh…
Despite her clumsy engagement with her fans, it seems like the experience was very inspiring for her.
